# Layout

Design guidance and example descriptions. Referenced registrations own the implemented values.

Sources: [SKILL.md](../../skills/ux-css-layout/SKILL.md), [design-tokens.instructions.md](../../instructions/design-tokens.instructions.md).

## Introduction

Make the primary task lead. Use spacing and grouping before adding separators, and keep the layout readable as available space changes.

## Arrange the primary task

Give the main task the leading area, with navigation and supporting details around it.

## Adapt to available space

Use minimum sizes, priorities, and collapsible panes to keep the main task usable as space narrows.
